nodes.label: Color Palette & Semantic Role Tokens
nodes.rationale: Semantic color pairing (emerald/amber/rose/azure with 10% tint fills) acts as wayfinding through approval pipelines, letting status be read pre-attentively without heavy solid fills.

nodes.label: Filterable Data Table & Toolbar
nodes.rationale: Split toolbar separates debounced search and faceted filters (left) from export/import and primary CTA (right) to keep destructive/creating actions visually distinct from retrieval actions.

nodes.label: Layout Principles (App Shell, 4px Scale, Breakpoints)
nodes.rationale: Strict left alignment for reading axes plus right-anchored actions/numerics creates counter-balanced tension per row; skeleton symmetry preserves layout height so loading never causes layout shift.

nodes.label: Typography Rules (Inter / Geist Sans / JetBrains Mono)
nodes.norm_label: typography rules (inter / geist sans / jetbrains mono)
nodes.rationale: Inter chosen for tall x-height and open apertures for legibility at small sizes in dense tables; JetBrains Mono with tabular numerals so numeric columns align mechanically.

nodes.label: Dualitas Pakta Integritas (Persetujuan Umum vs Pakta Kontributor)
nodes.norm_label: dualitas pakta integritas (persetujuan umum vs pakta kontributor)
nodes.rationale: Splitting consent into an automatic 3-checkbox general agreement and a manually verified generated PDF lets legal obligations bind only after a student is actually accepted by a partner.

nodes.label: Gatekeeper KRS sebelum Plotting Dospem
nodes.rationale: The Assign Dosen Pembimbing button stays disabled until conversion reaches KRS_LOCKED_VERIFIED, preventing supervisors from being allocated to courses the student has not actually locked in Siadin.

nodes.label: Multi-Application & Auto-Withdrawal (Maks. 3 Lamaran)
nodes.rationale: Allowing up to 3 parallel applications improves match rate, but accepting one offer auto-withdraws the rest and returns quota to the partner queue so a single student cannot hold multiple seats.

nodes.label: Form Pendaftaran 3 Tahap (Stepper)
nodes.rationale: Academic data is pulled automatically from the study system and cannot be edited manually, removing input error surface at the source.

nodes.label: Representasi Dospem di Dashboard Mahasiswa
nodes.rationale: Sidebar menu removed; a neutral empty-state card before plotting and a populated card (avatar, NIDN, institutional email, read-only WAG link) after plotting keeps the information discoverable where the student already looks.

nodes.label: 18 State Resmi Siklus Hidup Pendaftaran MBKM
nodes.norm_label: 18 state resmi siklus hidup pendaftaran mbkm
nodes.rationale: 18 formal states grouped into 5 lifecycle phases, each with a fixed UI label and badge color, so status is unambiguous across student, coordinator, partner, and supervisor screens.

nodes.label: Pemetaan State ke Antarmuka Mahasiswa
nodes.rationale: Collapsing 18 formal states into 4 UI groups (belum_daftar, lolos_seleksi, aktif, selesai) lets the prototype simulate lifecycle with one store value while sidebar visibility changes per group.

nodes.label: CMS Kontributor: Dropzone Upload Foto Profil & Banner
nodes.norm_label: cms kontributor: dropzone upload foto profil & banner
nodes.rationale: Raw URL text input forced admins to host images externally first; a drag-and-drop uploader with URL.createObjectURL instant preview removes that dependency without requiring backend support.

nodes.label: Kartu Dosen Pembimbing di Dashboard Mahasiswa
nodes.norm_label: kartu dosen pembimbing di dashboard mahasiswa
nodes.rationale: Menu Dosen Pembimbing (/mahasiswa/dosen-pembimbing) is removed from the sidebar; the information moves to the main dashboard card so the student sees it in the place they already land.

nodes.label: Komponen Grup WhatsApp Bimbingan
nodes.rationale: A group invite link replaces the personal phone number so coordination is institutional and does not expose a lecturer's private contact.

nodes.label: KontributorDetail: Tab Mahasiswa & Dospem
nodes.rationale: Coordinators need fast visibility of which faculty supervisors accompany students at each partner; a joined relation table (NIM, student, position, supervisor, supervision status badge) answers that in one view.

nodes.label: Sidang Evaluasi: 1 Menu dengan 2 Tab
nodes.rationale: The student sidebar already holds 11 items; adding separate 'Pengajuan Sidang' and 'Hasil Sidang' level-1 items would violate Hick's Law and force vertical scroll, reducing usability, so one parent menu with two tabs is used.

nodes.label: Auto-Scroll Floating CTA Tombol Daftar (detail-mbkm.astro)
nodes.rationale: The long detail page puts the registration CTA far above the FAQ/footer, forcing tedious manual scrolling; a scroll-triggered floating pill (scrollY > 600px) keeps the primary action reachable and pulses the real button on click.

nodes.label: Standarisasi Penomoran Tabel (Kolom 'No.')
nodes.rationale: Audit found mixed '#' / 'No' / no numbering, and paginated tables resetting to 1 each page; a single formula (currentPage-1)*pageSize+(index+1) plus a fixed w-12..w-14 center-aligned first column gives global, stable row indices.

nodes.label: Alur Frontend Pakta: Unduh, Materai, Unggah, Verifikasi
nodes.norm_label: alur frontend pakta: unduh, materai, unggah, verifikasi
nodes.rationale: Physical signature plus Rp 10.000 stamp or e-materai keeps the document legally valid while the upload/verify loop stays inside the dashboard and /admin/pelamar queue.

nodes.label: Generator Dokumen Pakta Integritas Kontributor
nodes.rationale: The pacta is a tripartite agreement (student, contributor/partner, faculty) auto-generated after the student accepts an offer, so legal obligations are populated from real data rather than typed by hand.
nodes.source_location: §3 Spesifikasi Generator Dokumen Pakta Integritas Kontributor

nodes.label: Dualitas Pakta (General vs Kontributor Generated)
nodes.rationale: The contributor pacta is generated dynamically from the student profile and partner clauses so it carries legally specific force, unlike a static general consent checkbox.

nodes.label: KRS Siadin sebagai Gatekeeper Penetapan Dosen Pembimbing
nodes.norm_label: krs siadin sebagai gatekeeper penetapan dosen pembimbing
nodes.rationale: Partner selection results must be announced before the KRS period; a supervisor can only be assigned after course conversion reaches KRS_LOCKED_VERIFIED, so supervision always maps to courses actually taken.

nodes.label: Visibilitas Dosen Pembimbing di Profil Kontributor
nodes.norm_label: visibilitas dosen pembimbing di profil kontributor

nodes.label: Design System: Enterprise Academic & Workflow Workspace
nodes.norm_label: design system: enterprise academic & workflow workspace
nodes.rationale: Visual identity must support dense multi-role administrative and academic workflows; depth is achieved via subtle surface contrast and 1px hairline borders rather than heavy shadows or gradients, to prevent visual fatigue in information-dense views.

nodes.label: Spesifikasi Standar Komponen & Interaksi UI MBKM
nodes.norm_label: spesifikasi standar komponen & interaksi ui mbkm

nodes.label: Spesifikasi Teknis MBKM V2 (Index)
nodes.rationale: Spec set derived from the 25 October 2026 prototype evaluation coordination meeting and business-flow alignment with the MBKM Coordinator and development team.

nodes.label: Prinsip Dasar Alur MBKM
nodes.rationale: Five principles: single entry stepper; no formal pacta at the start; one student one active program; KRS before Dospem; administrative failure is not selection failure (revision returns student to queue without voiding acceptance).

nodes.label: Invarian 4: Mandatory Communication Channel
nodes.rationale: Assigning a supervisor requires a non-empty WhatsApp group link, guaranteeing an official coordination channel exists from the first day of supervision.

nodes.label: Invarian 3: Non-Destructive Revision
nodes.rationale: PAKTA_SUBMITTED -> PAKTA_REVISION does not cancel the application, so a clerical document defect cannot destroy a legitimate selection win.

nodes.label: Invarian 2: Single Active Acceptance
nodes.rationale: A student may have at most one OFFER_ACCEPTED application, preventing double-occupancy of partner quota.

nodes.label: Invarian 1: Zero-Ghost Tutoring
nodes.rationale: Dosen assignment implies KRS_LOCKED_VERIFIED, so no supervisor is ever assigned to a student whose course conversion is not locked and verified.

nodes.label: Penyederhanaan Navigasi Mahasiswa (Hick's Law)
nodes.rationale: Removing the 'Dosen Pembimbing' sidebar item and merging it into a dashboard card (with official WAG link replacing personal WA contact) reduces menu items, per Hick's Law reducing decision time; Sidang Evaluasi stays a single menu with 2 sub-tabs.

nodes.label: Pemisahan Alur (Flow) dan State Machine
nodes.rationale: Separating 'who does what, in what order' from 'which data states are legal and what guards transitions' into two independent files prevents logic confusion between development team members.

nodes.label: Pergeseran Posisi Pakta Integritas Formal
nodes.rationale: Initial registration (Stage 3) is only general-terms consent via checkbox; formal signing is deferred to post-acceptance by partner/supervisor before SKS conversion, so students are not bound to legal documents for programs they may never join.
